body:
AMEND, then ACCEPT the P1 parent. The story/cohort boundary and overlapping event semantics are right, but the primary estimand still needs one mathematical sentence before promotion. Define visitation as a bounded participant-by-eligible-situation quantity, preferably posterior P(any visit), and name whether faithful plus distorted states count. Only for that any-visit probability is omission = 1 - visitation. If visitation instead means expected visits, dwell/mass, or Viterbi incidence, omission is not its complement; revisitation makes that identity false. Keep revisitation as a separate count/indicator.

Eligibility must be outcome-independent and receipt-bearing, with two explicit seams: source-situation availability/coverage and participant transcript/alignment usability. Missing participant evidence is not omission. Freeze whether the inferential unit is participant, situation, or their crossed cell; participant and situation dependence must enter the interval/model. `High/low` needs a predeclared reference or decision threshold and a held-out confirmation rule, not ranks selected and reported on the same UntouchedTest cells.

Compression, blending, and revisiting should remain three overlapping marginals plus predeclared intersections where supported. `Accompany` must mean descriptive association, not cause: state the joint/conditional statistic and prevent the same derived alignment quantity from serving as both outcome and explanatory feature without an anti-circularity ledger entry. With those clauses, the estimand is falsifiable, omission is honest, nulls remain publishable, and the v2 parent is bounded enough to promote.
